name: Moonwarden Ledger Weights

rarity.note: Precision craft, no Glimmer — but accuracy this trusted is its own magic.

summary: The calibrated brass weights every Moonwarden uses to settle debts, measure grain tithes, and record births against standard measures. Stamped with the crescent-over-circle and re-certified yearly at the local Halo. Half the continent's commerce runs on trust in these small objects; the other half runs on arguing about them.
origin: Standardized at the Crown Re-set charters (~120 AA)
current_whereabouts: Every Moonwarden's ledger-kit; master sets in Velkash and Hallord.
properties: Yearly certification stamps wear a ring into the brass — an unbroken stamp-ring means never questioned
Deep-folk smiths certify the master sets; their weights and the Crown's agree to within a hair
A 'questioned weight' in court voids every contract measured with it since last certification
keepers: Moonwardens; forging one attacks the continent's whole system of debt.
value_or_danger: Worth a few shards. Capable of collapsing a grain market.
adventure_hooks: A master set drifts out of true; every contract in three towns is voidable until players find who filed it.
A forged weight certifies a harvest that never existed — the loan is due, and the forger has vanished.
